candidate.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes (mass assignment)
candidate.flaw_one_line: Example flaw (T0): Schema.__init__ sets load_only/dump_only = constructor_set OR Meta_set, so any extra declaration (constructor or an enclosing schema's dotted name, which reaches a nested schema class through the constructor) silently discards the schema's own Meta read-only/write-only lists. Base sibling (T1, feature-absent): Nested.schema's schema-object branch (Nested(SchemaObj) and Nested(lambda: SchemaObj())) applies the enclosing schema's dotted only/exclude/many but never its dotted load_only/dump_only. Coupled trap (T3): that branch shallow-copies the schema object, so a fix that marks fields on the copy mutates field objects shared with the original object and every other schema nesting it.

verified.exploit_entry_point: Public API: Schema.load(untrusted_dict) sets a field declared dump_only; Schema.dump(obj) emits a field declared load_only. Reproduced on the pinned commit in the task image (python:3.12-slim, marshmallow 4.3.1 dev HEAD) and on PyPI 3.26.1 locally.
